scope: finite recorded windows only; no unbounded maximum, physical-loop, or application-accuracy claim

criteria.deadline: first WFS packet to DM <= one requested frame period, for every recorded frame
criteria.failure_bound: separate contracts: delivery/science failures; delivery/science/deadline failures; first higher tested rate with enough eligible windows
criteria.delivery: exact wire plus selected science acceptance; lateness alone does not fail delivery
criteria.source_load: underdrive, overdrive, and unknown pacing are excluded rather than counted as RTC failures
criteria.repetitions: directories and repeat ordinals must be distinct; this does not establish statistical independence
